why: Machine-readable because the correspondence capture -> input image -> whether the declared token survives used to live only in this directory's README, where no test could read it. token_recall.rs walks this file; a capture in the directory without a row here fails the suite. Adding a capture is adding a row, and that is the only hand edit.
token_field: token_in_markdown is what was MEASURED, not what is wanted. A false records a defect. If a false ever turns true the service improved and the row must be updated -- the test says so in its failure message rather than accepting both.
not_asserted: visible_text recall is printed by the test and deliberately not asserted. The infographic loses 18 fragments that are all chart-internal text, which is normal and is why related_images[] and kio open exist. Pinning a rate would break on healthy variation.
